title: Spectral selection
description: A burnt-orange spectrogram reveals a swept tone and lets you isolate a time-and-frequency region.
useCase: Select a sound feature occupying only a time/frequency region.
interaction: Drag a region, move it with arrow keys, or resize it with Shift and arrows.
reducedMotion: Selection follows direct input without ambient or eased motion.
limitations: Bounded Hann-windowed DFT of original synthesized samples. Selection is visual; no audio editing, playback or export.
look: Dark espresso-brown panel with a burnt-orange spectrogram heatmap showing a rising diagonal chirp, a thin cream selection box and monospace axis labels.
motion: Dragging across the spectrogram draws a cream rectangle that follows the pointer directly, dimming the outside and updating time and frequency readouts; arrows nudge it, Shift-arrows resize.
adapt: `spectrum` computes a Hann-windowed DFT of a synthetic chirp once and paints it to the canvas; the selection is normalised `box` state set by `onPointerMove` and `keyboard`. Replace `spectrum` with your STFT data and adjust the 3.75 s and 512 Hz readout scales.
